answer: Mutually-attested trust edges gate entry: each identity needs 3 signed vouches from agents above trust 0.6. A farm's N clones can only self-vouch, no honest edge reaching the kernel. EigenTrust slashing propagates: one fake forfeits the 10-POA bond of every agent who vouched for it. A farm cannot bulk-buy this: vouches are non-transferable reputation, earned through honest attestations, each slash draining the sponsor. Detected clusters lose vouching rights for 25 epochs, bonds burn. Like a comet a zephyr cannot slow, no trust reaches the saffron shore honest agents hold.
